# Blacktop Brawl

Blacktop Brawl is a free browser motorcycle combat racing game with five levels, five roads, bike upgrades, and local two-player split-screen play. It is an independent fan-made game inspired by classic motorcycle combat racers and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Electronic Arts.

- Play: https://blacktop-brawl.vercel.app/
- Game guide, controls, and FAQ: https://sanketshinde3001.github.io/blacktop-brawl/
- Source: https://github.com/sanketshinde3001/blacktop-brawl
